note: Marketing summaries only. Verify earn rates and transfer partners on each issuer site before you apply.

cards.name: Revolut Plus
cards.earnSummary: Everyday spend in EUR; useful for separating travel money from your main bank.
cards.transferNote: Does not transfer to Avios directly. Pair with a points card when you are ready to move miles.

cards.name: Revolut Premium
cards.earnSummary: Higher FX allowances and travel perks; still not an Avios transfer card.
cards.transferNote: Use for FX and trip budgeting; earn Avios elsewhere.

cards.name: American Express Gold (ES)
cards.earnSummary: Membership Rewards-style earn on eligible spend (illustrative).
cards.transferNote: Often transfers to Iberia Plus / Avios at promotional ratios — confirm live offers.

cards.name: Iberia Visa Signature
cards.earnSummary: Avios on Iberia and partner purchases (illustrative rate).
cards.transferNote: Miles land in Iberia Plus; good when you fly Oneworld from Spain.
